page: Microsoft Azure M416ds_12_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family. It features 416 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server is equipped with an exceptionally large memory capacity of 11,400.0 GB, providing approximately 27.4 GB of RAM per core. Additionally, it includes 410 GB of local SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable.

This server is designed for workloads requiring massive memory footprints and high-density compute resources. Because it lacks dedicated GPU accelerators, processing relies entirely on the 416 dedicated Intel vCPUs. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the server represents a highly specialized, ultra-high-density hardware class. The massive memory-to-vCPU ratio minimizes the need to distribute large datasets across multiple smaller instances, reducing network overhead and simplifying cluster management for massive workloads.

The M416ds_12_v3 is engineered for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, massive data warehousing, real-time analytics, and complex enterprise resource planning systems. The combination of dedicated compute cores, local SSD storage, and vast memory capacity ensures stable performance for transactional and analytical database operations.
